topic: Waterproof a rain jacket that's lost its repellency
core_question: How do I restore the water-repellency of a rain jacket that's soaking through? (secondary: How do I avoid or minimize jet lag when flying across time zones?)
answer_summary: Wash the jacket with a technical cleaner to remove buildup blocking the fabric's pores, then reactivate the DWR coating with heat (dryer/iron) or reapply a spray-on or wash-in DWR treatment.; after the topic shift: In the days before the flight, gradually shift bedtime toward the destination time zone; during and after travel, seek sunlight during destination daytime hours, stay hydrated, and avoid alcohol and long naps to reset your circadian rhythm faster.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; using casual slang
